adamgribac: On the way to S-S13, Rafael Adamgribac tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Rafael Adamgribac found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S13 with the rations. Rafael Adamgribac ate while listening to the revised orders.

Rafael Adamgribac got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Adamgribac is number 505 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Rafael Adamgribac heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Rafael Adamgribac and Arno Ricks carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Rafael Adamgribac pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Sorrow Copse and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
adolfdavis194: Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at Q-F22 changed before the cheering ended. Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis shouldered another load.
Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.

Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis was carrying water up to Q-F22 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis did not. Shot by Karel Littlerattae of the Concord (@littlerattae). Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis was hit at Q-F22 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Karel Littlerattae of the Concord (@littlerattae).
The House of Adolfdavis sent Karel Adolfdavis after Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
bananarail: On Day 6 Albin "Spark" Bananarail took a post at S-S9 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He keeps feeding the rats, and the men liked him for it.

Albin "Spark" Bananarail drew the street leading to Lindenbruck. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin "Spark" Bananarail. Albin "Spark" Bananarail read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Albin "Spark" Bananarail taught Walter Byzantineemp to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Albin "Spark" Bananarail borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Albin "Spark" Bananarail tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S9, Albin "Spark" Bananarail listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Albin "Spark" Bananarail borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin "Spark" Bananarail is number 376. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S9. Albin "Spark" Bananarail has learned to walk bent double.
A parcel came for Albin "Spark" Bananarail that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Albin "Spark" Bananarail and Walter Byzantineemp carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. Albin "Spark" Bananarail's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
commander.satan: The quartermaster asked Pavel "Tin" Satan to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The First Wave ribbon marked Pavel "Tin" Satan as an early volunteer. At R-F13, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
Pavel "Tin" Satan walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Pavel "Tin" Satan spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction.
Pavel "Tin" Satan saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.

After the shelling at R-F13, nobody could account for Pavel "Tin" Satan. His kit remains beside the bunk. After the loss of Hill 304, Pavel "Tin" Satan helped stack spare sandbags at R-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Pavel "Tin" Satan reappeared at R-F13 carrying a scrap of map from another unit. The route home had been drawn over somebody's shopping list.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Pavel "Tin" Satan helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Pavel "Tin" Satan polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Pavel "Tin" Satan put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.

At R-F13 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Pavel "Tin" Satan turned around and took a shovel blow. Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud). Blackwater Canal is lost. Pavel "Tin" Satan heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Pavel "Tin" Satan before dusk. Pavel "Tin" Satan read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Pavel "Tin" Satan is whole again, or near enough for the line. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F13 with the rations. Pavel "Tin" Satan ate while listening to the revised orders.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F13. Pavel "Tin" Satan took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo of the Hegemony (@titlefightlover37). Pavel "Tin" Satan was killed at R-F13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo of the Hegemony (@titlefightlover37).
The House of Satan sent Valentin "Owl" Satan after Pavel "Tin" Satan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
On sentry duty Valentin "Owl" Satan watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
elbert_nathanael: Day 9. The corporal put Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Rafael Tmpar of the Concord (@t3mp1ar369). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home reached Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael before dusk. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A letter from home reached Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael before dusk. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael read it twice and slept a little easier. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael transferred to the machine gunners. The men in S-R18 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Brass cases piled up around Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael's boots at S-R18. Out of all those rounds, one found Rafael Tmpar, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael before dusk. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
elementalhero25_: They issued Oskar Elementalher a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his brother's pocket watch in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar Elementalher kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home reached Oskar Elementalher before dusk. Oskar Elementalher read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Elementalher heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Oskar Elementalher is number 936. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Oskar Elementalher helped stack spare sandbags at R-R14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Oskar Elementalher felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Bastian "Mud" Hi of the Hegemony (@hi691812).
The medics cleaned Oskar Elementalher's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R14.
goldjacky_: After 8 days of war, R-S15 had a place for everything. On Day 8, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Konrad Goldjacky.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Konrad Goldjacky waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Konrad Goldjacky during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Konrad Goldjacky of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Grey Mill. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss's name scratched on the lid. Konrad Goldjacky got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 575. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Konrad Goldjacky let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Konrad Goldjacky carried three men out of R-S15 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
Konrad Goldjacky found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
jaymo_travel: Day 10. The corporal put Jakub "Bones" Travel beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

A newspaper reached Jakub "Bones" Travel with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F10, Jakub "Bones" Travel listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Jakub "Bones" Travel had just lit a cigarette at P-F10 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jakub Soukup of the Hegemony (@vazeny_pan_soukup).
The medics cleaned Jakub "Bones" Travel's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at P-F10.
jenscx: Day 11. The corporal put Benedikt Jenscx beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Jenscx kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Someone asked Benedikt Jenscx to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Benedikt Jenscx before the night shift. Benedikt Jenscx folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt Jenscx obtained a recipe for a steamed suet pudding. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks. A letter from home found Benedikt Jenscx before the night shift. Benedikt Jenscx folded it small and kept it close.
johnnyboi_jl: The draft reached R-R14 on Day 9. Benedikt Johnnyboi was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Johnnyboi watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Benedikt Johnnyboi could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt Johnnyboi is number 932. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Johnnyboi kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet hit Benedikt Johnnyboi in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-R14. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus of the Hegemony (@oscizzus). Benedikt Johnnyboi was hit at R-R14 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus of the Hegemony (@oscizzus).
Nils Johnnyboi had heard about Benedikt Johnnyboi's courage. At R-R14, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Nils Johnnyboi saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
juliofck: Anselm "Doc" Juliofck took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Anselm "Doc" Juliofck laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Anselm "Doc" Juliofck walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Anselm "Doc" Juliofck kept Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Doc could have walked there blind.
Anselm "Doc" Juliofck wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
knightowlvt: Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt stepped off the supply cart at R-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F12 is closed now. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt of the Concord and Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Sorrow Copse all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Coldwater. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Thunder all night. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt flinched at every crack. The old hands said that is how you spot the new ones. By morning, they were flinching too.

Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt was on watch at R-F12 when the night raid hit. The men found Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).

Oskar Knightowlvt came to the front because his cousin Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt never came home. He carries a rosary of rough beads. Oskar Knightowlvt was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F12 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Oskar Knightowlvt's ear at R-F12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Yann Zannwaffen of the Hegemony (@zannwaffen_). News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F12 with the rations. Oskar Knightowlvt ate while listening to the revised orders.
Oskar Knightowlvt's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Oskar Knightowlvt was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
na.da.na: At the depot, Leopold Nadana had practised answering to his name. At S-R2, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Leopold Nadana was hit through the stomach at S-R2. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Matthias Gasmask of the Concord (@travelling_gasmask). Leopold Nadana was killed on watch at S-R2. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Matthias Gasmask of the Concord (@travelling_gasmask).
The papers connected Bastian Nadana to Leopold Nadana. The men took longer to learn Bastian Nadana's own habits, but they made the effort.

Someone in S-R2 asked Bastian Nadana about Greyhallow. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter from home reached Bastian Nadana before dusk. Bastian Nadana read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian Nadana helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Bastian Nadana has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. A letter from home reached Bastian Nadana before dusk. Bastian Nadana read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Nadana woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep. A letter from home reached Bastian Nadana before dusk. Bastian Nadana read it twice and slept a little easier.
naterrwaterr: The old hands of S-C12 have been here since Day 1. Gustav Naterrwaterr has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Gustav Naterrwaterr folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Gustav Naterrwaterr asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Gustav Naterrwaterr got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 943. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Naterrwaterr let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Bone Quarry every night, fed by Leopold Mejci on one side and Gustav Naterrwaterr on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
Gustav Naterrwaterr saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
nile9nile: Casimir Nile came up on Day 8 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Casimir Nile and Isidor "Saint" Imerv argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Casimir Nile was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Zeno Jordanillman of the Hegemony (@jordanillman). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Casimir Nile read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The medic looked at Casimir Nile's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S17. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir Nile answered to number 586. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-S17. Casimir Nile has learned to walk bent double.
A beetle crawled across Casimir Nile's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
Casimir Nile and Silas Chirotama have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
nthuff66: Day 9. The corporal put Silas Nthuff beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Silas Nthuff has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Severin Xboxme, grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Silas Nthuff kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Silas Nthuff's bunk. He has named it Napoleon. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F13 with the rations. Silas Nthuff ate while listening to the revised orders.
Silas Nthuff tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Silas Nthuff kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
olliedav124: The sergeant gave Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-R16. Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav has learned to walk bent double.

Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 975. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-R16, Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Tobias Pilot was grazed. Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav ate breakfast without a word.
robertoneill2008: Dorian Robertoneill came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Dorian Robertoneill found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.

Dorian Robertoneill was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Dorian Robertoneill folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Dorian Robertoneill fired at a movement across the wire at S-F21. The man went down: Dorian Noahz, grazed.
The stores supplied Dorian Robertoneill with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language.
The gun crews at S-F21 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Leopold Ker was grazed.
Dorian Robertoneill counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Nils Mas was badly wounded.

Dorian Robertoneill was on the dawn watch at S-F21 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Dorian Robertoneill was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord (@tyleraldridge45). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Dorian Robertoneill shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Dorian Robertoneill's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Dorian Robertoneill was carried in at last. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian Robertoneill answered to number 294. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Dorian Robertoneill did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Dorian Robertoneill seemed to get better for a day. Then he did not. He died in the ward with a stub of a pencil under his pillow.
Ulrich "Lucky" Robertoneill came to the front because his uncle Dorian Robertoneill never came home. He carries a stub of a pencil.
Ulrich "Lucky" Robertoneill snores. Valentin Helpmed does not. Valentin now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
scuffx28: After 9 days of war, S-C8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Matthias "Brick" Scuffx.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Matthias "Brick" Scuffx wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Matthias "Brick" Scuffx was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Brick" Scuffx is number 729 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Matthias "Brick" Scuffx did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Matthias "Brick" Scuffx was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu was grazed.
Matthias "Brick" Scuffx had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke, grazed.
sf_alien101: Viktor Alien walked into P-F21 on Day 11 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at P-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Viktor Alien shouldered another load.
Viktor Alien fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Norbert Daddy, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Viktor Alien polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
snixx_93: The sergeant gave Walter Snixx a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Walter Snixx was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Zeno Jordanillman was badly wounded. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Walter Snixx wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Walter Snixx got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Snixx stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Walter Snixx fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Bastian Abdukarimov, now grazed.
Walter Snixx and Ulrich Cylone have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
speckyjp: Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp approved the method. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp. Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp wrote down the news without trying to explain it. Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp transferred to the snipers. The men in P-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp reads Cyril Mace's letters from home out loud, because Cyril never learned to read. Crow leaves out the sad parts. Cyril knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp. Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp fired at a movement across the wire at P-F4. The man went down: Norbert Fejobo, gravely wounded.
the_e_point_wtm: Lucien "Tin" Wtm introduced himself as a tram conductor from Rosenau. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Lucien "Tin" Wtm heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Lucien "Tin" Wtm had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Cyril Rotten crossed it, Lucien "Tin" Wtm fired. Cyril Rotten was badly wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Lucien "Tin" Wtm is number 917 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Lucien "Tin" Wtm read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Lucien "Tin" Wtm could not stop listening to it.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Lucien "Tin" Wtm's bunk. He has named it Captain.
williambeckett444: The old hands of S-R12 have been here since Day 1. Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R12. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony (@parker.j.mccauley). Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Three days with a bandage, and Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke is back at S-R12. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke answered to number 874. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-R12. Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke has learned to walk bent double.
Behind the lines Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke had a bath in a beer vat with eleven other men. The water was brown before he got in.

A bullet hit Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke's belt buckle at S-R12 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Matthias "Brick" Scuffx of the Hegemony (@scuffx28).
